name: Defender of the True World
intro: Some druids specialize in protecting Golarion from the threat of First World inhabitants. They are devoted to tracking down, diverting, and slaying fey threats.

features.name: Class Skills
features.text:
A defender of the true world gains Diplomacy as a class skill.

This alters the druid’s class skills.

features.name: Bonus Languages
features.text: A defender of the true world can select Aklo, Sylvan, or Undercommon as bonus languages, in addition to the normal list of bonus languages available.

features.name: Enemy of the First World
features.text:
A defender of the true world cannot use summon nature’s ally to summon fey creatures.

This modifies spontaneous casting.

features.name: Fey Empathy
features.text:
A defender of the true world gains a +2 competence bonus on Bluff, Diplomacy, and Intimidate checks when interacting with fey creatures. This bonus increases by 1 for every 4 druid levels she has (maximum +7 at 20th level).

This replaces wild empathy.

features.name: Fey Stalker
features.text:
At 3rd level, the defender of the true world’s animal companion and any creatures she summons with summon nature’s ally gain a +1 morale bonus on attack and damage rolls against fey creatures. This bonus increases to +2 at 8th level, +3 at 13th level, and +4 at 18th level.

This ability replaces trackless step

features.name: Feybane
features.text:
At 4th level, a defender of the true world doesn’t gain a bonus on saving throws against spells and effects that utilize or target plants. She instead treats her natural attacks as cold iron for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction, and she gains a +2 bonus on caster level checks to overcome the spell resistance of fey creatures.

This ability alters resist nature’s lure.

features.name: Beguiling Immunity
features.text:
At 9th level, a defender of the true world becomes immune to the mind-affecting effects of fey.

This ability replaces venom immunity.

features.name: First World Deceiver
features.text:
At 13th level, a defender of the true world gains the ability to change her appearance as per alter self, except she can take the form of a humanoid or fey creature. Her base land speed from this ability cannot exceed 60 feet.

This ability replaces a thousand faces.
